problem: Native-parent threaded-comment regressions exposed XLSX acceptance of mentions without comment text, and a feature-matrix claim of package-level thread CRUD that the public XLSX API does not expose.
changes: Apply one shared missing-text invariant during XLSX comment parsing and model validation, which also guards the writer. Comments without mentions retain optional text.
Add six native-parent integration tests for XLSX eager/source readers, ordinary cell-edit preservation, external relationship refusal, and XLSB metadata edit lifecycle/atomicity/owner admission.

Correct the XLSX feature matrix to distinguish bounded model/codec authoring and package reads from a source-checked package-level threaded-comment editor. Raw public OPC construction in tests does not establish such an API.
Bind only xlsx-220 and xlsb-298 to the new partial evidence; preserve the historical authoring inventory, native fixture bytes and existing reviewed scope boundaries.

verification_scope.xlsx_readers: Explicit people/threaded-comment parts are added through public OPC to immutable native XLSX, XLSM and protected XLSX parents. Exact field assertions cover root/reply IDs, cell anchors, person IDs/display names/user/provider IDs, Unicode text, timestamps, absent/false resolution states and mention IDs/offsets. Both eager and source-backed readers agree; the mention substring Bob follows a surrogate-pair emoji.
verification_scope.xlsx_preservation: Setup checks all original data/member payloads outside the three declared graph files, every original content type/relationship, root relationships and the exact part catalog plus two additions. File save/reopen retains all members. Ordinary Z100=65 publication is read back and preserves thread/person, VBA and legacy-note/VML payloads; retained-owner inverse restores every member. The protected native worksheet refuses with EditBlocked(ProtectedSheet) and remains unchanged.
verification_scope.xlsx_invalid_input: A malformed native-parent thread part with mentions but no text now refuses through eager and source readers; direct model validation and writing return Invalid with the shared missing-text reason. A no-text comment without mentions remains valid. External persons and threaded-comment relationship derivatives return their precise Invalid reasons before target access.
verification_scope.xlsb_lifecycle: Native classic-note and leading-chart workbook parents receive explicit typed people, root/reply/mention and opaque-extension metadata. Create, reply update, resolution, person rename, thread/worksheet-owner/people removal retain expected semantics and part/relationship identities. Every committed stage saves/reopens, replays and exactly inverts. Only the selected person/thread XML changes on update; original cells, notes, drawings and all unowned members/effective graph edges remain exact.
verification_scope.xlsb_refusals: An exact UTF-16 range ending at the text boundary stages; one unit beyond refuses without losing valid staging. Missing text, invalid range, missing parent/person and a reply with a cell anchor return the exact InvalidValue graph refusal. Referenced-person removal and stale patch replay refuse. A native chartsheet cannot own a worksheet thread part: commit returns the exact Unrecognized reason, and reset commits an exact no-op.
verification_scope.limits: All threaded-comment additions and malformed/external variants are explicitly library-authored derivatives. No native-authored threaded-comment corpus specimen, package-level XLSX thread editor, automatic legacy placeholder generation, provider lookup, collaboration behavior, external retrieval, macro execution or fresh Excel reopen/UI validation is inferred.

specification_evidence.finding: Mentions identify people and index comment text; persons and root/reply attributes carry the metadata tested here. Comment text is optional. The missing-text check enforces the existing bounded model invariant for nonempty mention lists; UTF-16 offsets are qualified as the library contract, not a new claim about native-app UI behavior.

specification_evidence.reference: Public XLSX threaded_comments and XLSB comments::threaded package/edit contracts
specification_evidence.finding: XLSX exposes typed codecs plus eager/source reads, while XLSB exposes source-checked package editing. Tests and feature documentation preserve this distinction.

reproductions.observed: Before the fix, the native-parent eager worksheet reader returned Ok(Some(Comments)) with root text=None and a nonempty mention at UTF-16 start 3, length 3. The independent model/writer path skipped the same presence invariant.
